observations: Photo 0: a large flat panel TV leaning against a wall on a tiled floor, front view only, with a thin silver-grey metal bezel.
The screen is switched off and reflects the room; no picture is shown.
No brand logo, model number or size marking is readable anywhere on the bezel in photo 0.
No stand or feet attached, no remote, no power cable, no back panel or label shown.
No crack is visible on the reflective screen at this angle, but a dark glossy panel hides cracks and pressure marks when off.

identity.kind: large flat screen smart TV (seller says 55 inch)
read_from: photo 0 front of the TV, no logo or label readable

claims.evidence: No Samsung logo or label is readable in photo 0; the back label is not shown.
The TV looks large next to the floor tiles in photo 0, but no size marking or model number is shown.
Screen is off; no home screen or apps shown.

risks.risk: Brand, size and model are not what the seller says, which sets the price.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the sticker on the back showing the model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; held until the back label is shown

risks.risk: Screen cracked, lines, dead pixels, backlight failure or no power, common for a TV shown off and without a stand.
risks.proof: Clip of the TV powering on and showing a bright full screen picture, then the smart home screen.

risks.risk: Stand, remote or power cable missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the stand, remote and power cable laid out next to the TV.
risks.if_unproven: priced as TV alone without stand or remote

risks.risk: Back casing, ports or mounting points damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the full back of the TV including the ports.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the worst seen condition

proof_requests: Photo of the back label showing the model number
Clip powering the TV on to a full screen picture and the smart home screen
Photo of the stand, remote and power cable
Photo of the full back with the ports
response.reason: No brand, model or size can be read in photo 0 and the screen is off, so the identity that sets the price comes only from the seller's text; the back label is needed before even a worst case price is possible.
